verdict.rationale: Gusto's API exposes payroll data (payrolls, payroll reports per gusto-docs-44/40/46) and webhooks (payroll.paid) that an agent could pull to reconcile into a ledger, and the MCP dev-assistant server (gusto-docs-6/34/gusto-probe-3) lets AI tools interact with the Embedded Payroll API directly, supporting agent-driven retrieval. However there's no documented journal-entry-specific export format, no explicit accounting-ledger reconciliation endpoint or GL mapping feature, and no evidence of a purpose-built 'payroll journal' report distinct from generic payroll reports. Missing for 10: explicit payroll journal entry/GL export endpoint, documented reconciliation workflow or ledger-mapping guidance, and independent evidence of an agent successfully performing this reconciliation end-to-end.
